cases.title: resources → filtered search → article → real back/forward preserves URL and scroll
empty, no-match, page bounds and history remain distinct
mock failure retries without losing query and slow old searches never replace the latest intent
narrow article, keyboard TOC and signup preserve the email draft without external calls
landing menus enter the three original introductions and all artwork stays local and static
introduction email drafts are scoped, repeated submits deduplicate, and cancellation returns to the source
FAQ keyboard controls reveal dated answers, close prior answers and hand off locally
related articles retain stable destinations, real history and an explicit unknown page two
narrow introductions and demo handoff preserve focus, Escape, scroll and visible content
scroll never changes a session and the dashboard header requires an explicitly chosen mock session
landing loads local Gellix and all original sections, with no preview tools or APIs
menus support hover, keyboard, Escape, outside click, template selection and local handoffs

cases.title: email validation, IME, retry, back retention, cancel and refresh stay in memory
testimonial, finance, branding, footer disclosure and history restore real scroll
narrow widths, mobile menu, long Korean input, zoom and reduced motion keep controls usable
G01 reset clears public draft while session and component previews remain separate
mobile close and breakpoint changes clear submenus and keep keyboard targets reachable
each public destination family has an explicit local Goal boundary
older signup history resolves its own draft and return page after a second introduction handoff
